title: Smart Data Models - OCDS - Organization
description: A party (organization) (Open Contracting Data Standard 1.1.5, Organization: https://standard.open-contracting.org/schema/1__1__5/release-schema.json#/definitions/Organization. Field names are kept verbatim except 'id' -> 'ocdsId' and 'value' -> 'ocdsValue'.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity (NGSI-LD). Built from the OCDS identifiers, see the model notes.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Organization'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://standard.open-contracting.org/schema/1__1__5/release-schema.json#/definitions/Organization/properties/name'. Common name. A common name for this organization or other participant in the contracting process. The identifier object provides a space for the formal legal name, and so this may either repeat that value, or may provide the common name by which this organization or entity is known. This field may also include details of the department or sub-unit involved in this contracting process.

ocdsId.description: Property. Model:'https://standard.open-contracting.org/schema/1__1__5/release-schema.json#/definitions/Organization/properties/id'. Entity ID. The ID used for cross-referencing to this party from other sections of the release. This field may be built with the following structure {identifier.scheme}-{identifier.id}(-{department-identifier}). OCDS field 'id', renamed because 'id' is reserved in NGSI-LD.

identifier.description: Property. Model:'https://standard.open-contracting.org/schema/1__1__5/release-schema.json#/definitions/Organization/properties/identifier'. Primary identifier. The primary identifier for this organization or participant. Identifiers that uniquely pick out a legal entity should be preferred. Consult the [organization identifier guidance](https://standard.open-contracting.org/1.1/en/schema/identifiers/) for the preferred scheme and identifier to use.

scheme.title: Scheme
scheme.description: Organization identifiers should be taken from an existing organization identifier list. The scheme field is used to indicate the list or register from which the identifier is taken. This value should be taken from the [Organization Identifier Scheme](https://standard.open-contracting.org/1.1/en/schema/codelists/#organization-identifier-scheme) codelist.

id.title: ID
id.description: The identifier of the organization in the selected scheme.

legalName.title: Legal Name
legalName.description: The legally registered name of the organization.

uri.title: URI
uri.description: A URI to identify the organization, such as those provided by [Open Corporates](http://www.opencorporates.com) or some other relevant URI provider. This is not for listing the website of the organization: that can be done through the URL field of the Organization contact point.

additionalIdentifiers.description: Property. Model:'https://standard.open-contracting.org/schema/1__1__5/release-schema.json#/definitions/Organization/properties/additionalIdentifiers'. Additional identifiers. A list of additional / supplemental identifiers for the organization or participant, using the [organization identifier guidance](https://standard.open-contracting.org/1.1/en/schema/identifiers/). This can be used to provide an internally used identifier for this organization in addition to the primary legal entity identifier.

items.title: Identifier
items.description: A unique identifier for a party (organization).

scheme.title: Scheme
scheme.description: Organization identifiers should be taken from an existing organization identifier list. The scheme field is used to indicate the list or register from which the identifier is taken. This value should be taken from the [Organization Identifier Scheme](https://standard.open-contracting.org/1.1/en/schema/codelists/#organization-identifier-scheme) codelist.

id.title: ID
id.description: The identifier of the organization in the selected scheme.

legalName.title: Legal Name
legalName.description: The legally registered name of the organization.

uri.title: URI
uri.description: A URI to identify the organization, such as those provided by [Open Corporates](http://www.opencorporates.com) or some other relevant URI provider. This is not for listing the website of the organization: that can be done through the URL field of the Organization contact point.

address.description: Property. Model:'https://standard.open-contracting.org/schema/1__1__5/release-schema.json#/definitions/Organization/properties/address'. Address. An address. This may be the legally registered address of the organization, or may be a correspondence address for this particular contracting process.

streetAddress.title: Street address
streetAddress.description: The street address. For example, 1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy.

locality.title: Locality
locality.description: The locality. For example, Mountain View.

countryName.title: Country name
countryName.description: The country name. For example, United States.

contactPoint.description: Property. Model:'https://standard.open-contracting.org/schema/1__1__5/release-schema.json#/definitions/Organization/properties/contactPoint'. Contact point. Contact details that can be used for this party.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the contact person, department, or contact point, for correspondence relating to this contracting process.

email.title: Email
email.description: The e-mail address of the contact point/person.

telephone.title: Telephone
telephone.description: The telephone number of the contact point/person. This should include the international dialing code.

faxNumber.title: Fax number
faxNumber.description: The fax number of the contact point/person. This should include the international dialing code.

url.title: URL
url.description: A web address for the contact point/person.

roles.description: Property. Model:'https://standard.open-contracting.org/schema/1__1__5/release-schema.json#/definitions/Organization/properties/roles'. Party roles. The party's role(s) in the contracting process, using the open [partyRole](https://standard.open-contracting.org/1.1/en/schema/codelists/#party-role) codelist. (OCDS open codelist partyRole.csv.)

details.description: Property. Model:'https://standard.open-contracting.org/schema/1__1__5/release-schema.json#/definitions/Organization/properties/details'. Details. Additional classification information about parties can be provided using partyDetail extensions that define particular fields and classification schemes.
